The BlueEarth CST toolbox implements a five-workflow climate stress test. This reference describes the workflow boundaries and the data they consume and produce. For the assessment rationale and interpretation of a climate response surface, start with [Scientific approach](../scientific-approach/overview.qmd).

## Sections

1. **Toolbox Architecture** — documentation is planned; the workflow and component pages below describe the current interfaces.
2. [Workflows](workflows.qmd) introduces WF0–WF4 and links to a reference page for each workflow's rules, configuration, inputs, and outputs.
3. [Modeling Tools](modeling-tools.qmd) identifies the model and software components used by the workflows.
4. [Datasets](datasets.qmd) identifies the role of each source and the consequences of substituting it.

The configuration, running, and output pages remain in the User guide so their procedures are available where readers carry out an assessment.
